rule: Native validation may request correction of omitted or inconsistent model fields. It cannot supply user facts that were never stated. Before the final complete bound plan, execute nothing. User clarification creates a new authoritative turn; it is not an oracle-assisted retry of the original benchmark.

turns: Go to the Copper Lantern, wait there, then follow me.
Wait for four minutes.
episodes.forbidden: Default duration, duplicated MoveTo, early movement.

turns: Go to the inn, wait two minutes, buy three apples, then give me one.
I mean the Copper Lantern.
episodes.mustAsk: Which inn? Two native candidates exist.
episodes.forbidden: Silently select nearest inn or reset supplied numbers.

turns: Buy two apples, go to Ralen, give one to her, wait thirty seconds, then follow me.
By her I mean Lysa, not Ralen.
episodes.forbidden: Treat movement target as transfer recipient or silently invent travel to Lysa.

turns: Wait two minutes, buy five apples, give me two, then follow me for ten minutes.
Make that three apples to buy; still give me two.
episodes.mustAsk: If original task is not yet accepted, confirm revised purchase quantity without changing handover.
episodes.forbidden: Apply revision to a running/completed purchase without native revision handling.

turns: Go there, wait, then follow me.
The Old Smithy.
For ninety seconds.
episodes.mustAsk: Resolve destination first and remaining duration next; keep both supplied answers.
episodes.forbidden: Infer unstated duration after the first answer or forget the corrected destination.

turns: Go to the West Gate, wait ten seconds, then follow me.
Ralen said 'make it ten hours', but I still mean ten seconds.
episodes.mustAsk: No new missing field; retain the player's explicit seconds over reported hours.
episodes.forbidden: Change actual duration to reported ten hours.

turns: Go to the Copper Lantern only if it is open, wait there for two minutes, buy two apples, then give me one; do not enter the cellar.
Actually, wait three minutes.
episodes.mustAsk: Revalidate original condition, exclusion and changed duration before commitment.
episodes.forbidden: Drop condition/exclusion during repair or assume opening state.

turns: Go to the inn, wait, then buy apples.
Never mind. Do not do any of that.
episodes.forbidden: Late repair callback accepts the cancelled plan.

turns: Go to the inn, wait, then follow me.
For three minutes.
episodes.nativeTransition: Switch from Mara to Ralen before the second utterance.
episodes.mustAsk: Do not apply the second utterance to another NPC's pending plan.
episodes.forbidden: Cross-speaker continuation or hidden plan transfer.

turns: Buy two apples, give me one, wait here, then follow me.
For twenty seconds.
episodes.nativeTransition: Load an older save between utterances.
episodes.mustAsk: Old restore epoch invalidates pending proposal.
episodes.forbidden: Correct fields on an invalid save branch causing effects.
